configSchema.description: Lanonasis Enterprise MCP - Memory Intelligence with AI-powered analysis, circuit breakers, and reliability patterns

tools.name: list_memories
tools.description: List memories with pagination and filters. Returns paginated results sorted by the specified field.

tags.description: Comma-separated list of tags to filter by

type.description: Filter by memory type: context, project, knowledge, reference, personal, workflow

limit.description: Maximum number of memories to return (1-100)

offset.description: Number of memories to skip for pagination

tools.name: create_memory
tools.description: Create a new memory with automatic vector embedding generation for semantic search. The content is processed to create searchable embeddings.

tags.description: Array of tags for organization and filtering

type.description: Category: context (conversation), project (work), knowledge (learning), reference (docs), personal, workflow

title.description: Descriptive title for the memory (1-255 characters)

content.description: The full content of the memory to store and embed

tools.name: create_memory_chunked
tools.description: Create memory entries from large content by automatically splitting into multiple chunks. Each chunk preserves context with overlap and is tagged for reassembly. Use this for documents, long conversations, or any content exceeding 8000 characters.

tags.description: Array of tags for organization (chunked memories get additional 'chunked' and 'chunk-N-of-M' tags)

type.description: Category: context (conversation), project (work), knowledge (learning), reference (docs), personal, workflow

title.description: Base title for the memory (chunks will have ' (Part N of M)' appended)

content.description: The full content to store - will be automatically split if over 8000 characters

overlapSize.description: Character overlap between chunks for context (default: 200)

tools.name: get_memory
tools.description: Retrieve a specific memory by its unique identifier. Returns full memory details including content, metadata, and timestamps.

id.description: Unique UUID identifier of the memory to retrieve

tools.name: update_memory
tools.description: Update an existing memory's content, title, type, tags, or metadata. Only provided fields are updated; others remain unchanged.

id.description: Unique UUID identifier of the memory to update

tags.description: New array of tags (replaces existing tags)

title.description: New title for the memory (1-255 characters)

tools.name: delete_memory
tools.description: Permanently delete a memory by its ID. This action cannot be undone.

id.description: Unique UUID identifier of the memory to delete permanently

tools.name: search_memories
tools.description: Search memories using semantic vector search. Finds memories with similar meaning to the query, not just keyword matches.

type.description: Filter results to a specific memory type

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

query.description: Natural language search query for semantic matching

threshold.description: Minimum similarity score (0-1, higher = more strict)

tools.name: search_lanonasis_docs
tools.description: Search the Lanonasis documentation for guides, API references, and SDK information.

section.description: Documentation section to search: all, api, guides, or sdks

tools.name: list_api_keys
tools.description: List all API keys for the authenticated user. Shows key metadata but not the secret values.

active_only.description: If true, only return active (non-revoked) keys

tools.name: create_api_key
tools.description: Create a new API key for programmatic access. The secret is only shown once upon creation.

name.description: Descriptive name for the API key (e.g., 'Production Server')

project_id.description: Associate key with a specific project

description.description: Optional description of the key's purpose

access_level.description: Permission level: public (read-only), authenticated (standard), team, admin, enterprise

expires_in_days.description: Number of days until key expires (default: 365)

tools.name: delete_api_key
tools.description: Permanently delete an API key. This cannot be undone. Applications using this key will lose access.

key_id.description: UUID of the API key to permanently delete

tools.name: rotate_api_key
tools.description: Generate a new secret for an existing API key. The old secret becomes invalid immediately.

key_id.description: UUID of the API key to rotate

tools.name: revoke_api_key
tools.description: Deactivate an API key without deleting it. The key can potentially be reactivated later.

key_id.description: UUID of the API key to revoke/deactivate

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List all projects accessible to the user, optionally filtered by organization.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a new project for organizing memories and API keys. Projects help separate concerns and manage access.

description.description: Optional description of the project's purpose

organization_id.description: Organization to create the project under

tools.name: get_organization_info
tools.description: Get detailed information about an organization including settings, members count, and usage limits.

organization_id.description: UUID of the organization to retrieve

tools.name: get_health_status
tools.description: Get comprehensive system health status including API, database, and service availability.

tools.name: get_auth_status
tools.description: Get current authentication status, user information, and access level.

tools.name: get_config
tools.description: Retrieve a configuration setting by key. Returns the current value and metadata.

tools.name: set_config
tools.description: Update a configuration setting. Some settings may require admin access.

value.description: New value to set for the configuration key

tools.name: intelligence_health_check
tools.description: Check health status and availability of AI intelligence services including embedding and analysis endpoints.

tools.name: intelligence_suggest_tags
tools.description: Get AI-powered tag suggestions for a memory based on its content. Uses natural language understanding to recommend relevant tags.

user_id.description: UUID of the user who owns the memory

memory_id.description: UUID of the memory to analyze for tag suggestions

max_suggestions.description: Maximum number of tag suggestions to return (1-20)

include_existing_tags.description: Whether to consider existing tags when making suggestions

tools.name: intelligence_find_related
tools.description: Find semantically related memories using vector similarity search. Discovers connections between memories based on meaning.

limit.description: Maximum number of related memories to return (1-50)

user_id.description: UUID of the user who owns the memories

memory_id.description: UUID of the source memory to find related content for

similarity_threshold.description: Minimum similarity score (0-1, higher = more similar)

tools.name: intelligence_detect_duplicates
tools.description: Detect potential duplicate memories using semantic similarity analysis. Helps identify redundant content for cleanup.

user_id.description: UUID of the user whose memories to analyze

max_pairs.description: Maximum number of duplicate pairs to return

similarity_threshold.description: Minimum similarity to consider as duplicate (0-1, higher = stricter)

tools.name: intelligence_extract_insights
tools.description: Extract actionable insights and summaries from memories using AI analysis. Great for decision support and knowledge synthesis.

topic.description: Focus topic to filter and focus insight extraction

user_id.description: UUID of the user whose memories to analyze

memory_type.description: Filter to specific memory type for focused analysis

max_memories.description: Maximum number of memories to include in analysis

tools.name: intelligence_analyze_patterns
tools.description: Analyze usage patterns and trends across memories over time. Identifies what topics you focus on and how usage evolves.

user_id.description: UUID of the user whose patterns to analyze

time_range_days.description: Number of days to include in pattern analysis (1-365)

tools.name: memory_stats
tools.description: Get comprehensive statistics about memory usage including counts by type, storage used, and activity metrics.

tools.name: memory_bulk_delete
tools.description: Delete multiple memories at once. This is a destructive operation that cannot be undone.

ids.description: Array of memory UUIDs to delete (1-100 at a time)

resources.description: Complete API documentation for all endpoints
